description: This file declares functions related to the Flash Attention mechanism, including forward and backward passes for multi-head attention with variable sequence lengths, optimized for CUDA. It provides interfaces for attention calculations, handling optional tensors, and supporting various configurations like causal masking, window restrictions, and softmax scaling.

methods.name: mha_fwd
methods.description: Performs standard multi-head attention forward pass with support for optional outputs, sparsity adaptions, and scaling parameters.

methods.name: mha_varlen_fwd
methods.description: Performs variable-length sequence multi-head attention forward pass, suitable for batching sequences of different lengths.

methods.name: mha_bwd
methods.description: Backward pass for the multi-head attention, computing gradients with respect to query, key, and value tensors.

methods.name: mha_varlen_bwd
methods.description: Backward pass for variable-length sequence multi-head attention, handling gradients for batched sequences with different lengths.
